ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_dynamic_logsigmoid_weighted_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Repaired to reduce similarity by replacing the tanh-relu hinge margin formulation with a dynamic logsigmoid-based margin loss leveraging advantage_gap as a weighting factor. Instead of clamping and smoothing with tanh and relu, we use logsigmoid of the margin (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) which naturally encourages margin separation and is numerically stable. Weighting by absolute advantage_gap remains to emphasize stronger pairwise differences. This removes overlap with tanh-relu hinge patterns from other candidates and maintains differentiability, numerical stability, and effective pairwise ranking loss behavior.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
margin = lpw - lpl
log_sigmoid_margin = logsigmoid(margin)
weighting = abs(adv_gap)
weighted_loss = -log_sigmoid_margin * weighting
if weight exists:
  weighted_loss *= weight
final_loss = mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    log_sigmoid_margin = ops.logsigmoid(margin)
    weighting = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    loss = ops.mul(ops.neg(log_sigmoid_margin), weighting)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
